summary: Routes frontend-only shell and component changes through a complete frontend verification lane without starting an unrelated database and backend stack.

notes: The change affects CI routing only and does not alter runtime persistence or the supported database matrix.

security: Mixed, authorization-sensitive, persistence, engine, and unknown changes continue to select the broader fail-closed verification paths.
documentation: The maintainer CI routing guide documents the focused frontend lane and its fail-closed boundary.
knownLimitations: The exact merge-group revision still runs applicable checks; this change does not yet implement cryptographically bound cross-run evidence reuse.
rollback: Revert the classifier output and frontend job; frontend-only changes will return to the PostgreSQL application lane.
validation: Classifier fixtures replay the prior frontend regression change and prove PostgreSQL, Oracle, engine-browser, image, and backend application lanes stay unselected.
The focused lane passed both frontend typechecks, 1,494 unit tests, and frontend lint locally.
